title: 云计算和SaaS行业的最新发展与结构分析
core_insight: 云计算和SaaS行业正在经历快速的发展，云厂商和SaaS厂商都在推出新的产品和服务，尤其是在AI和云原生领域

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud、Azure和火山引擎都在推出新的云原生服务和产品，包括Agent Sandbox、Agent Executor和ByteHouse AWS Graviton基于的RG实例提供了更快的数据仓库和数据湖查询性能，Adobe推出了新的AI和机器学习应用 AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS Transform at 1 year, Claude Platform on AWS, EC2 M3 Ultra Mac instances, and more Amazon Redshift introduces AWS Graviton-based RG instances with an integrated data lake query engine How Glance turns hours of video into mobile-ready clips with AI Letting machine learning choose the right font for everyone 从 ClickHouse 到 ByteHouse：实时数据分析场景下的优化实践
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出新的欧洲主权云服务，Azure和火山引擎都在扩展其计算能力 AWS Graviton基于的RG实例提供了更快的计算性能，Cloudflare重建Browser Run产品，提高了性能和可靠性 AWS parades orgs that took up its offer for Euro Sovereign Cloud 火山引擎正式推出全系云产品 Browser Run: now running on Cloudflare Containers, it’s faster and more scalable
dimension_texts.application: Google Cloud、Adobe和HubSpot在多个行业推出了新的应用，包括媒体、娱乐和零售 企业正在使用Google Cloud、Adobe和HubSpot的服务进行数字化转型 Urban Outfitters achieves major cost savings by moving Sterling OMS to AlloyDB for PostgreSQL Behold the bold — announcing the 2022 Adobe Experience Maker Awards winners Best AI search analytics tools for marketing teams
dimension_texts.capital: Convective Capital raises an $85 million fund to build disaster resilience Spotify和Universal Music strike deal allowing fan-made AI covers and remixes Elon Musk will have more than 50% of the voting power in SpaceX Convective Capital raises an $85 million fund to build disaster resilience Spotify and Universal Music strike deal allowing fan-made AI covers and remixes
